recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Tuvalu. Parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a commonwealth realm.
capital: Funafuti · the capital is an atoll of 29 islets; administrative offices are in Vaiaku Village on Fongafale Islet
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by Governor General Tofiga Vaevalu FALANI (since 29 August 2021); Prime Minister Feleti Penitala TEO (since 27 February 2024)
government: parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy; a Commonwealth realm
economy: upper middle-income Pacific island economy; extremely environmentally fragile; currency pegged to Australian dollar; large international aid recipient; subsistence agrarian sector; Te Kakeega sustainable development; domain name licensing incomes GDP (PPP): $57.055 million (2023 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: no regular military forces; Tuvalu Police Force
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
